message.secondshift.altar.no_job_block: The position is unfilled. Socket a job-site item into the altar before you file the paperwork.
message.secondshift.altar.not_a_workstat: That block posts no job. Only a real workstation defines the role.
message.secondshift.altar.no_soul_block: Nothing to bind. Bring a Soul Block to staff this altar.
message.secondshift.altar.occupied: This altar already has an employee. One position, one hire.
message.secondshift.altar.closed.altar_g: The altar is gone. Consider the interview concluded.
message.secondshift.altar.closed.job_gon: The workstation was removed. The position is rescinded.
message.secondshift.altar.closed.too_far: You stepped away from the altar. The paperwork goes unfiled.
message.secondshift.altar.empty_pool: This position has nothing to offer yet. No trades are on file for this role.
message.secondshift.employee.ready_for_p: is ready for a promotion (tier %s)! Visit the altar to choose their new trades.
message.secondshift.altar.no_promotion_p: This employee hasn't earned a promotion yet. Keep trading.
message.secondshift.happiness.cause.quar: no valid quarters (needs an enclosed 3x3+ room with a door, near the altar).
message.secondshift.happiness.cause.food: no food nearby (needs a stocked chest with bread, potato, carrot, or beetroot).
message.secondshift.happiness.cause.none: quarters and food are both in order.
message.secondshift.employee.quit: %s has had enough and quit. Their Soul Block hits the ground; the altar is free again.
secondshift.configuration.title: Second Shift Configuration
advancement.secondshift.necromantic_appr: Hold an emerald and feel the payroll calling. Forge a Harvester — emeralds, bone, and soul soil — and go collect what the village owes you.
advancement.secondshift.first_harvest.de: You reaped a villager and pocketed their Soul Fragment. Keep at it — four make something more solid.
advancement.secondshift.soul_mason.title: Soul Mason
advancement.secondshift.soul_mason.descr: Four fragments, one Soul Block. Now build the Soul Altar and set a job-site block on top to open a position.
